inboxes_has_domain.name: inboxes_has_domain
inboxes_has_domain.value: "inboxes"."domain_id" is not null or "inboxes"."shared_domain_id" is not null

inboxes_receiving_address_shared.name: inboxes_receiving_address_shared
inboxes_receiving_address_shared.value: "inboxes"."receiving_address" is null or "inboxes"."shared_domain_id" is not null

received_email_inboxes_unread_idx.name: received_email_inboxes_unread_idx
received_email_inboxes_unread_idx.where: "received_email_inboxes"."read_at" is null and "received_email_inboxes"."delivered_at" is not null

received_email_inboxes_held_idx.name: received_email_inboxes_held_idx
received_email_inboxes_held_idx.where: "received_email_inboxes"."quarantined_at" is not null and "received_email_inboxes"."released_at" is null
